business_problem: Accumulation of data from each construction project was housed in multiple locations, leading to delays in getting timely feedback to governance teams, leadership, and project teams.
solution_summary: Burns & McDonnell built its Microsoft solution to improve cloud migration and platform modernization. Accumulation of data from each construction project was housed in multiple locations, leading to delays in getting timely feedback to governance teams, leadership, and project teams. Key components included Microsoft Fabric held and organized governed data, and Azure Databricks ran model inference or heavy processing. Operational data flows into Microsoft Fabric, where Microsoft Fabric applies transformations and business logic before Microsoft Fabric delivers governed insights to teams across Burns & McDonnell. The governed Microsoft stack gave Burns & McDonnell a reusable foundation for data analytics, data platform while keeping deployment, security, and day-to-day operations inside the Microsoft estate.
